meta.purpose: Self-auditing manifest for concrete numeric/factual claims on the hamz.ai lab pages and builder page. Each machine-checkable claim maps to an evidence source in one of the two repo checkouts; claims with no in-repo source are listed under 'attested' with a reason. Consumed by verify-lab-claims.py.
meta.note_on_matrix: Two distinct studies are quoted on the site and must not be conflated. (1) The July-2 skills A/B: 26/50 -> 46/50 must-hits over 16 tasks, 8 skills; it backs lab/evidence/ and the skills card. (2) The effort-lattice matrix (results/matrix/matrix.json, NUMBERS.md): 15 scored cells over a frozen 17-task suite, and it IS now quoted across lab/lattice/, its explorer, its guided tour, lab/index.html, lab/learn/ and builder/. A 16-task claim is correct for study (1) and WRONG for study (2); the page_literal checks below pin that boundary.
